outcome: Passed every check of the time. Rejected on review: bullet 1 blames the merge queue, which the data shows is the fast stage.

bullets.text: Merged changes typically move from review-ready to merged in a median 7.3 days; the slowest 10% of merged PRs took over 64 days, showing the merge queue can be lengthy for outliers.
There are 272 open PRs with no human response yet, sitting in the initial review queue for a median 41 days.
A large review queue is waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm across the repo: 368 open PRs are waiting with a median wait of 69 days.
Some changes have already cleared review but are waiting for an approver: 54 open PRs have lgtm and are waiting for an approver, with a median wait of 26 days in the approver queue.
Author-side work queue size is close to the reviewer lgtm queue: 337 open PRs are waiting on their author with a median wait of 51 days, close to the 368 waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm.
